subject: Evaluation MAP & ramp proposal — FluxRetail (requested TPM cadence)
messages:
From: Sasha Reed <sasha@fluxretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Benji Cole <benji.procurement@fluxretail.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evaluation & ramp plan for FluxRetail

Jonas / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and cost controls look promising for our recommendation engine pilot. We sketched a MAP to align evaluation milestones and a commercial ramp. High level:

- Evaluation window: 6 weeks (functional + perf + integration)
- Acceptance gates: week 2 (basic integration), week 4 (initial perf / quality), week 6 (production readiness)
- Target TPMs: pilot month 1 = 50k TPM, month 3 = 150k TPM, month 6 = 300k TPM
- Ask: proposed pricing tiers, any ramp discounts, and SLA/credit structure if perf misses the gates

We attach the MAP summary (FluxRetail_MAP_v1.pdf). Budget owner (Benji) is looped in for procurement constraints. Goal: finalize commercial terms and a mutual timeline this month so we can start the eval in early October.

Questions we have today:
1) Can you provide a written ramp cadence with price per 1M tokens and the discount schedule tied to committed TPM?
2) Do you offer a credit or trial token pool if acceptance criteria aren't met?
3) Typical DocuSign + SOW lead time once commercial is agreed?

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Reed
Head of Data Products, FluxRetail
S: +1 415 555 0198

Attachment: FluxRetail_MAP_v1.pdf (1 page)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha@fluxretail.com>
Cc: Benji Cole <benji.procurement@fluxretail.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation & ramp plan for FluxRetail

Sasha — great to see the MAP laid out, looks aligned with how we typically structure pilots. Quick answers up front and a proposed commercial ladder below.

Summary answer: yes — we can support a staged TPM ramp tied to discounted tiers and provide a contingency token pool for failed acceptance gates. Typical DocuSign lead time is 3–5 business days once final SOW is accepted.

Proposed ramp + pricing (per 1M tokens):
- Pilot (0–100k TPM): $60 / 1M tokens
- Growth (100k–250k TPM): $48 / 1M tokens
- Scale (250k+ TPM): $38 / 1M tokens

Ramp cadence (example):
- Month 1 (pilot): 25k TPM committed, evaluation pool 50k free tokens to validate integration
- Month 2: 75k TPM committed
- Month 3: 150k TPM committed (Growth tier pricing applies from month 3)
- Month 6: 300k TPM committed (Scale tier pricing applies)

Discounts / credits:
- Signing within 30 days: additional 10% one-time ramp discount
- If acceptance gate missed (week 6), we provide up to 1 month of credit equal to the pilot token pool (max 50k) and a remediation plan at no cost

Attachments: redwood-rate-sheet-2026Q3.pdf with sample SOW language for MAP-driven rollouts.

Next steps I propose:
1) Benji / procurement confirm whether 25k initial commit is workable or if you need a lower starting point
2) If you prefer a lower initial commit, we can trade that for a slightly reduced signing discount (we can be flexible)
3) Once cadence is agreed, I’ll generate the SOW and DocuSign packet and loop in Legal for a quick review

Looping Lauren and Marissa for approvals on the one-time credit and the accelerated-signing discount.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-rate-sheet-2026Q3.pdf

From: Benji Cole <benji.procurement@fluxretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sasha Reed <sasha@fluxretail.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation & ramp plan for FluxRetail

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few procurement points:

- Our budget is strict for Q4. We cannot commit 25k TPM on month 1 up front; preferred starting commit is 10k TPM with a defined upgrade path tied to acceptance gates.
- We need a stronger SLA credit if performance/availability issues block production. The one-month token credit is a good start; can you provide a 5% service credit applied to the next invoice per missed SLA threshold (max two occurrences)?
- We will need standard procurement language and a statement of work via DocuSign. Please include export/security clauses and SOC 2 evidence references.

If you can accept 10k TPM start with the ramp to 300k by month 6 (subject to acceptance gates), we can move to DocuSign. If a signing discount is required, we prefer it front-loaded and constrained to the first three billing periods.

Thanks — Benji
Benji Cole
Senior Procurement Manager, FluxRetail
Attachment: procurement_terms.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Reed <sasha@fluxretail.com>, Benji Cole <benji.procurement@fluxretail.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: approval request — concession for FluxRetail (10k pilot start + credits)

Lauren / Marissa — quick internal ask before I lock terms with FluxRetail. Procurement wants to start at 10k TPM (not our preferred 25k). To keep the deal moving I’m proposing we accept:

- 10k TPM initial committed pilot month (one-month evaluation pool = 50k free tokens as part of MAP)
- Ramp to 300k TPM by month 6, tied to MAP gates
- One-month token credit (up to 50k) if week 6 acceptance fails
- SLA service credit: 5% invoice credit per SLA miss (cap 2 occurrences)
- Signing discount: 8% applied to first three billing cycles if they sign within 30 days

Rationale: keeps the customer in the funnel (they will trade early commit size for a stronger discount/credit). The financial impact is limited (small pilot commit) but increases CAC risk if they churn. I recommend we approve the 8% front-loaded discount and the SLA credit; we should keep the 10% option reserved for enterprise/legal asks.

If you approve, I’ll generate the SOW/DocuSign packet with the security addendum and HubSpot will be updated to reflect the ramp plan.

— Jonas
(Internal)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Reed <sasha@fluxretail.com>, Benji Cole <benji.procurement@fluxretail.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: approval request — concession for FluxRetail (10k pilot start + credits)

Jonas — approve the concessions with these constraints:
- 8% signing discount limited to first three invoices only (document explicitly)
- Token-credit language must include remediation milestones and a cutover plan (no open-ended credits)
- SLA credit OK but require Legal sign-off on the exact thresholds and caps

Proceed to generate the SOW / DocuSign packet. Loop Legal for the SLA language and Security for the SOC 2 references.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reed <sasha@fluxretail.com>, Benji Cole <benji.procurement@fluxretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation & ramp plan for FluxRetail — confirmation & next steps

Sasha / Benji — thank you. Per approvals, we will proceed with the following confirmed MAP terms:

- Pilot start: 10k TPM committed, evaluation pool: 50k trial tokens available in month 1 for integration and perf testing
- Ramp: target 300k TPM by month 6 contingent on acceptance gates at weeks 2 / 4 / 6
- Pricing: as previously proposed (pilot pricing will be applied pro-rata)
- Signing discount: 8% applied to first three invoices if DocuSign completed within 30 days
- SLA: 5% invoice credit per missed SLA threshold, cap two occurrences — Legal to finalize thresholds
- Credit for failed acceptance: up to 50k token credit with remediation milestones (defined in SOW)

I’ll send a DocuSign packet with the SOW and security addendum by Monday. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FLR-82421. Expect DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/FLR-2026-SOW

Next steps for you: please confirm the signing timeline and the procurement contact for PO issuance.

Best — Jonas
